title: 第2章 耳听为虚

content_zh:
姜似冲阿蛮略一颔首，轻声道：“去吧。”
阿蛮得了吩咐，从腰间荷包中摸出一把钥匙，轻手轻脚走上前去开锁。
随着钥匙轻轻转动，门锁发出轻微的咔嚓声，随之而开。
阿蛮握着钥匙的手心已经湿漉漉的，松了口气的同时只觉心跳如雷。
姜似见此，露出浅淡的笑意来。
前不久她吩咐阿蛮与管二门钥匙的婆子吃酒，待那婆子喝多了，趁机翻找出钥匙在准备好的几块香胰子上拓了个印，拿到外面打了几把新钥匙来。
只不过这样制出来的钥匙能否阿蛮一点一点把门推开，眼睛亮亮的：“姑娘——”
这时忽然听到吱呀一声响，在这只闻鸟语虫鸣的夜里显得格外刺耳。
主仆二人对视，皆望到对方眼中的惊恐。
姜似很快反应过来，拽着阿蛮矮下身去，就看到守门的婆子走出来，揉着眼睛向茅厕走去，竟没有往这边看一眼。
姜似忙钻过侧门，阿蛮紧随其后，轻轻把门关拢。
虚惊过后，阿蛮露出庆幸的笑容：“好险！”
姜似已经整理好了心情，淡淡道：“不要多言，快些走。”
主仆二人顺着墙角往前而去，走了约莫一盏茶的工夫姜似忽然停了下来。
阿蛮环顾四周，有些茫然：“姑娘，咱们怎么出去呀？”
她能设法弄到开二门的钥匙，大门可就不成了，没有姑娘的贴身丫鬟找门房老头儿吃酒的道理。
“跟我来。”姜似绕过一丛花木，弯腰拨开墙角茂盛青草，赫然露出一个洞口来。
阿蛮猛然睁大了眼睛：“姑娘，这里怎么有个洞？”
姜似并没有回答，而是俯身从洞口钻了出去，被府外的夜风一吹，仰望着夜空有片刻出神。
那时候，兄长姜湛在她眼里是个不学无术的，她对他一直爱理不理，有一次偶然瞧见他从这个洞里爬出来，显然是偷溜出去玩了。

她当时不过冷笑一声，对他越发瞧不上眼，甚至连通知管事把这个洞堵上的心思都没有。
在她看来，她的兄长便是那扶不上墙的烂泥，已经没有任何挽救的必要，还不如躲远些图个清静。
可是姜湛死在了她出阁后的那个秋天，得闻噩耗的她才赫然发觉她原来也会伤心的。
那个哪怕被父亲用鞭子抽了一顿后还巴巴把从街上买来的玫瑰莲蓉糕给她送来的兄长不在了。
“姑娘——”从洞口钻出来的阿蛮见姜似出神，轻轻喊了一声。
姜似收回思绪，自嘲一笑。
那时候的自己真是猪油蒙了心，二叔家的大堂兄再出类拔萃也不会给她送玫瑰莲蓉糕，她的兄长再怎么不争气，疼爱她的心是真切的。
“走吧。”姜似恢复了平静，算了一下时间，带着阿蛮快步往莫忧湖而去。
好在当朝取消了宵禁制，而莫忧湖与东平伯府都在城西，给姜似提供了很大方便。
主仆二人匆匆赶到那里，借着皎洁月色，遥遥看到了伫立在湖边的一双身影。
阿蛮当时就惊了，压低声音道：“姑娘，真的有人！”
姜似面无表情指指湖边矗立的一块写有“莫忧湖”三个大字的顽石。
那石头足有半丈多高，人躲在石头后绰绰有余。
阿蛮会意，跟着姜似躲在了那处。
姜似手扶着石壁，手心传来淡淡温热，是石壁白日积攒的热还未消散。
很快有啜泣声顺着湖边的风吹过来，姜似忍不住探头望去。
月光皎洁，清晰照出二人的样子。
男子身形偏瘦，高出女子近一个头来，正是姜似的未婚夫季崇易。
姜似的目光从季崇易俊美的面上一掠而过，落在女子脸上。
她一直很好奇，那个能让季崇易守着如花似玉的新婚妻子却从来不碰一下的女子长什么样子。

她嫁过去时，那女子已经不在人世了，直到今夜才有机会一窥真容。
女子身材娇小，柳叶眉下是一双含了雾的大眼睛，尽管沐浴着月光，依然能瞧得出来肤色不算白皙。
姜似心情瞬间有些复杂。
平心而论，这女子算得上眉清目秀的小家碧玉，但与顶尖的美人儿还是有很大差距的，且她后来听说这位民家女没读过什么书……
姜似目光再次移到季崇易脸上，看到他面上真切的痛苦与焦灼，不得不承认，她这是输给了真爱呀。

content_en:
Jiang Sichong nodded slightly to Aman and said softly: "Go."
Ah Man got the order, took out a key from the purse at his waist, walked forward and unlocked the door softly.
As the key turned slightly, the door lock made a slight click and opened.
Ah Man's palm holding the key was already wet. He breathed a sigh of relief and felt his heart beating like thunder.
Seeing this, Jiang Xi smiled slightly.
Not long ago, she ordered Ah Man to have a drink with the woman who was in charge of the second door's keys. When the woman drank too much, she took the opportunity to find out the keys, made a mark on some prepared spices, and took them outside to punch some new keys.
But can the key made in this way allow Aman to push the door open bit by bit, his eyes bright: "Girl--"
At this time, I suddenly heard a squeaking sound, which was particularly harsh in the night when I heard the chirping of birds and insects.
The master and servant looked at each other, both seeing the fear in each other's eyes.
Jiang Si reacted quickly and dragged Ah Man down. He saw the woman guarding the door walking out, rubbing her eyes and walking towards the toilet without even looking over.
Jiang Si hurriedly got through the side door, followed closely by Ah Man, who gently closed the door.
After the false alarm, Ah Man showed a thankful smile: "What a risk!"
Jiang seemed to have sorted out his mood and said calmly: "Don't talk too much and walk quickly."
The master and servant walked forward along the corner. After walking for about a cup of tea, Jiang Si suddenly stopped.
Ah Man looked around, a little confused: "Girl, how are we going to get out?"
She could manage to get the key to the second door, but not the main door. There was no reason for a girl's maid to have a drink with the old concierge.
"Follow me." Jiang Si walked around a bush of flowers and trees, bent down and pushed aside the lush green grass in the corner, revealing a hole.
Ah Man suddenly opened his eyes: "Girl, why is there a hole here?"
Jiang Si did not answer, but leaned over and got out of the hole. Being blown by the night wind outside the house, he looked up at the night sky for a moment in trance.
At that time, her brother Jiang Zhan was unlearned and unskilled in her eyes, and she always ignored him. Once, she accidentally saw him crawling out of the hole, apparently sneaking out to play.
She just sneered and looked down upon him more and more. She didn't even think of informing the steward to plug the hole.
In her opinion, her brother was like the mud that couldn't hold up the wall. There was no need to save him, so it was better to hide away for peace and quiet.
But Jiang Zhan died in the autumn after she came out of the cabinet, and when she heard the bad news, she suddenly realized that she would be sad too.
The brother who kept bringing her rose lotus paste cake bought from the street even after being whipped by his father was gone.
"Girl -" Ah Man, who emerged from the hole, saw Jiang seemed to be in a trance and shouted softly.
Jiang Si retracted his thoughts and laughed at himself.
At that time, I was really blinded by lard. No matter how outstanding her second uncle's cousin was, he would not give her rose lotus paste cake. No matter how unsatisfactory her brother was, he truly loved her.
"Let's go." Jiang Si regained his composure, counted the time, and quickly headed towards Moyou Lake with Ah Man.
Fortunately, the curfew was lifted at that time, and Moyou Lake and Dongping Bo's Mansion were both in the west of the city, which provided Jiang Si with great convenience.
The master and servant hurried there, and under the bright moonlight, they saw a pair of figures standing by the lake in the distance.
Ah Man was shocked at that time and lowered his voice: "Girl, there really is someone!"
Jiang Si looked expressionless and pointed at a stubborn stone standing by the lake with the three characters "Moyou Lake" written on it.
The stone is more than half a foot high, which is more than enough for a person to hide behind it.
Ah Man understood and followed Jiang Si to hide there.
Jiang Si held his hand on the stone wall, feeling a faint warmth coming from his palm. It was the heat accumulated on the stone wall during the day that had not dissipated.
Soon there were sounds of sobbing blowing along the wind near the lake, and Jiang Si couldn't help but look over.
The moonlight was bright, clearly illuminating the appearance of the two of them.The man is thin and nearly a head taller than the woman. He is Jiang Si's fiancé Ji Chongyi.
Ginger-like eyes glanced across Ji Chongyi's handsome face and landed on the woman's face.
She had always been curious about what the woman who allowed Ji Chongyi to guard his beautiful newlywed wife but never touched her looked like.
When she got married, the woman was no longer alive, and it was only tonight that she had a chance to see her true appearance.
The woman is petite, with a pair of big foggy eyes under her willow eyebrows. Even though she is bathed in the moonlight, it can still be seen that her complexion is not fair.
Jiang Si's mood was a little complicated for a moment.
To be fair, this woman could be considered a Xiaojiabiyu with pretty features, but there was still a big gap between her and the top beauties. Moreover, she later heard that this girl from a private family had not read any books...
Jiang Si's eyes moved to Ji Chongyi's face again, and seeing the real pain and anxiety on his face, he had to admit that she had lost to true love.
